source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of interference in thin films (PDF 53-54).

blocks.text: Pani par tairti tel ki patli tah ya sabun ke bulbule se roshni mun'akis hone par aksar rangon ki roshan pattiyan nazar aati hain. Yeh interference ka nateeja hain. Roshni ki lehrein aisi patli tahon (thin films) ki agli aur pichhli satah se mun'akis hoti hain, aur dono mun'akis lehron (jin ke raaste ki lambai mukhtalif hai) ka constructive interference mukhtalif wavelengths ke liye mukhtalif jagahon par hota hai. Fig 15.11 mein t motai ki patli tah par parne wali roshni ka kuch hissa oopar ki satah se mun'akis hota hai (rasta abc); oopar ki satah se guzarne wali roshni ka kuch hissa neeche ki satah se mun'akis hota hai (rasta abdef). Dono mun'akis lehrein aankh par milti hain, jahan apne phase ke talluq ke mutabiq constructive ya destructive interference kar sakti hain. Mukhtalif rangon ki wavelengths mukhtalif hain, is liye interference kuch rangon ke liye constructive aur kuch ke liye destructive ho sakta hai.

Isi liye patli tahon mein rangeen naqshe nazar aate hain, jaise bulbule ki deewaren banane wali sabun ki patli tahein (kitab ki Fig 15.12 is ki tasveer hai) aur pani par tel ki patli tahein. Rangeen naqshon ki pecheeda shaklein tah ki motai mein farq se banti hain.

Taqreeban mutawazi do satahon se taqreeban amudi parne wali aik rang (monochromatic) ki roshni ka inikas lein. Fig 15.13 hawa ke patle wedge se juda do sheeshe ki plates dikhati hai. Hawa ke wedge ki dono satahon se mun'akis lehron ka rasta farq har nuqte par wedge ki motai t ka dugna hai. Jahan 2t wavelengths ka poora adad ho wahan constructive interference aur roshan jagah; jahan aadha-poora adad ho wahan destructive interference aur andheri jagah ki tawaqqo hai. Jahan plates chhooti hain wahan rasta farq taqreeban sifar hai, is liye roshan jagah ki tawaqqo hogi.

Tajurba karne par roshan aur andhere fringes nazar aate hain lekin ulat: jahan plates chhooti hain us lakeer par andhera fringe hai, roshan nahi. Is se zahir hai ke mun'akis lehron mein se aik inikas par aadhe chakkar ka phase shift leti hai, is liye chhoone ki lakeer par mun'akis dono lehrein barabar raste ke bawajood aadha chakkar out of phase hain. Yeh phase shift Maxwell ki equations aur roshni ki electromagnetic fitrat se predict hota hai; yeh tab hota hai jab roshni zyada refractive index wale medium (yahan hawa ki tah ke neeche sheesha) se mun'akis ho.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: hawa mein ray t motai aur n index ki patli tah se takrati; aik ray oopar ki satah se mun'akis aur doosri tah mein ja kar neeche se mun'akis; dono aankh ki taraf oopar. Oopar daen: do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan hawa ka wedge, aik sire par h oonchai ke patle spacer se juda, oopar baari baari andhere aur surkh fringe nishan. Neeche: Newton's rings: hamwar sheeshe par rakha plano-convex lens, aur andhere markaz wale hum-markaz andhere aur roshan halqe.
blocks.caption: Patli tahein, hawa ka wedge aur Newton's rings (Figs 15.11 se 15.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har surat mein patli tah ki oopar aur neeche ki satah se do inikas interference karte hain. Tah ki motai rasta farq tay karti hai; jahan yeh taqreeban sifar ho, aik inikas par aadhe chakkar ka shift fringe ko andhera banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Interference ke rang sabun ke bulbulon par kyun nazar aate hain lekin khirki ke sheeshe par kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Sabun ki tah sirf roshni ki aik wavelength jitni moti hai, is liye dono inikas ka chhota rasta farq alag rang deta hai. Khirki ka sheesha lakhon wavelengths mota hai, is liye rasta farq bohat bara aur thori mukhtalif motai aur zawiyon ke rang aapas mein mil kar mit jate hain.

items: Patli tah: oopar aur neeche ki satah ke inikas interference karte; rang motai par munhasir.
Hawa ka wedge: rasta farq 2t; inikas par aadhe chakkar ke shift se chhoone ki lakeer andheri.
